commands: php -r 'define("CLI_SCRIPT",true); require "/app/moodle/config.php"; $h=$CFG->dbhost; $u=$CFG->dbuser; $p=$CFG->dbpass; $n=$CFG->dbname; echo "H=$h U=$u N=$n\n"; $r=shell_exec("mariadb -h $h -u $u -p$p -D $n -e \"SELECT shortname,name,archetype FROM mdl_role WHERE shortname IN (\\\"manager\\\",\\\"editingteacher\\\");\" 2>&1"); echo $r; $r2=shell_exec("mariadb -h $h -u $u -p$p -D $n -e \"SELECT r.shortname,rc.capability,rc.permission FROM mdl_role_capabilities rc JOIN mdl_context ctx ON ctx.id=rc.contextid JOIN mdl_role r ON r.id=rc.roleid WHERE ctx.contextlevel=10 AND rc.capability LIKE \\\"moodle/course:%\\\" ORDER BY r.shortname,rc.capability;\" 2>&1"); echo $r2; echo DONE;'
